decisions.mark: identifies the cancellation observer thread as existing to bridge an atomic into a plain int, because the C ABI boundary cannot carry an atomic
decisions.detail: QUOTE: Mirrors the engine's interrupt flag into the C-ABI int cancel flag; "The C-ABI boundary passes a plain `int*` polled every 10 ms, because the design rules forbid `std::atomic` across the `.so` boundary." | WHY: The answer says observer/poller threads mirror the atomic interrupt flag into a plain int* for the C ABI because atomics can't cross the .so boundary. || QUOTE: Mirrors the engine's interrupt flag into the C-ABI int cancel flag; "The C-ABI boundary passes a plain `int*` polled every 10 ms, because the design rules forbid `std::atomic` across the `.so` boundary." | WHY: The answer says observer/poller threads mirror the atomic interrupt flag into a plain int* cancel flag because std::atomic can't cross the C ABI (.so) boundary. || QUOTE: Mirrors the engine's interrupt flag into the C-ABI int cancel flag; "The C-ABI boundary passes a plain `int*` polled every 10 ms, because the design rules forbid `std::atomic` across the `.so` boundary." | WHY: The answer says the observer/poller threads mirror the atomic interrupt flag into a plain int* for the C-ABI because std::atomic cannot cross the .so boundary.
